grades.quote: usertrap returns to userret (3151) which executes sret to user space.
grades.reason: The passage is about the RISC-V trap path from user space and only mentions that userret executes sret to return to user space. It never says what state SRET restores, such as pc from sepc, privilege mode from SPP, or the interrupt-enable bit from SPIE. It gives only auxiliary context on where sret is used.
